710 / 714: Cortech Cobra Mini Can Trash Receptacle
Product URL: https://www.anchortex.com/products/cortech-cobra-mini-can-trash-receptacle
Manufacturer page: https://cortechusa.com/products/furniture/facilities-maintenance/cobra-mini-can/
Spec sheet: 710 / 714
Recommended H1 and Subtitle
H1: Cortech Cobra Mini Can Trash Receptacle – 710 / 714
Current H1: Cortech Cobra Mini Can Trash Receptacle - 710, 714
Subtitle: Virtually Unbreakable One-Piece Molded 10 or 14 Quart Trash Can, Sold in Cases of 6
Current subtitle: Cortech USA 710, 714 Cobra Mini-Can Trash Cans
Revised Product Description
Headings marked [H2] should be set as H2 on the page.
The Cortech Cobra Mini Can Trash Receptacle is a small, virtually unbreakable trash can for cells, patient rooms, offices, and other rooms in correctional and behavioral healthcare facilities. It comes in 10 and 14 quart sizes and is sold in cases of 6.
The can is rotationally molded in one piece from high impact “no break” polyethylene, so it will not dent, rust, or chip. A rolled rim adds strength and holds the liner in place.
Material: One-piece rotationally molded high impact “no break” polyethylene
Sizes: 10 quart (710) or 14 quart (714)
Rim: Rolled rim for extra strength and to secure liners
Durability: Virtually unbreakable; will not dent, rust, or chip
Antimicrobial Testing: Tested to ISO 22196, showing a greater than 99% reduction in bacteria
Flammability Standards: Flame retardant; passes California Technical Bulletin 133 and UL 94 HB
Colors: Aqua, Black, Blue Gray, Brown, Burgundy, Canvas, Claylight, Gray, Green, Indigo, Midnight Blue, Moss, Overcast, Sand, Seagrass, Slate Blue, Stone Gray, or Tide (custom colors available on request)
Packaging: Sold in cases of 6
Warranty: Lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects
Country of Manufacture: USA, made to ISO quality standards
Available Models and Options
710 – 10 Quart: Cobra Mini Can, case of 6
714 – 14 Quart: Cobra Mini Can, case of 6
Installation and Options
No assembly is required.
[H2] Applications
The Cobra Mini Can suits rooms that need a small trash can that will not break.
Typical applications include:
Cells and housing units in correctional facilities and jails
Patient rooms in behavioral healthcare facilities and psychiatric hospitals
Offices, bathrooms, and other small rooms in secure facilities
Explore Anchortex's Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies collection for more trash receptacles and sanitation supplies.
[H2] About Cortech Facilities Maintenance
Cortech facilities maintenance products are molded to stand up to hard daily use in correctional facilities, behavioral healthcare facilities, and other high-abuse settings.
Cortech facilities maintenance includes:
Trash Receptacles: Cobra Cans in 20 to 55 gallon sizes, in flame retardant or food grade and general use material, and Cobra Mini Cans in 10 and 14 quart sizes
Can Dollies: Cobra Can dollies in two sizes
Carts: Kangaroo Carts and lids for laundry, trash, and material handling
[H2] About Cortech
Cortech manufactures durable molded furniture for demanding environments, including behavioral healthcare facilities, psychiatric hospitals, correctional institutions, law enforcement facilities, and homeless and emergency shelters. Explore the full line of Cortech Behavioral Health and Prison Furniture at Anchortex.
Meta Title and Description
Meta title (64 characters): Cortech Cobra Mini Can Trash Receptacle - 710 / 714 at Anchortex
Meta description (153 characters): Shop the Cortech Cobra Mini Can. A virtually unbreakable one-piece molded 10 or 14 quart trash can that will not dent, rust, or chip. Sold in cases of 6.
Notes and Questions
Series section: "About Cortech Facilities Maintenance" is a new section for the Cobra Can, Cobra Mini Can, can dolly, and Kangaroo Cart pages. It is the same on each of these pages.
Weight and size: your variants are set to 255 lbs, which looks like a placeholder. The Cortech spec sheet says "See Chart" for the weight but has no chart, and it gives no dimensions, so I left both out. Can you get the weight of a case of 6 from Cortech?
Colors: your variants are Black, Grey, Blue, Green, and Brown. The Cortech spec sheet lists 18 colors, and "Grey" and "Blue" are not Cortech color names (Cortech has Gray, Blue Gray, Slate Blue, and Midnight Blue). Would you like the color variants changed to match Cortech?
Warranty: your current page does not list a warranty. The Cortech spec sheet says lifetime warranty against manufacturing defects, so I added it.
Food grade: the Cortech web page says the Mini Can is "also available in a food grade material for general use," but the spec sheet does not list it, so I left it out.
Wall thickness: your current page says "0.20 Nominal wall thickness." The Cortech spec sheet does not say this, so I left it out.
Collection link: the Mini Can is in your Prison Janitorial and Sanitation Supplies collection, so I linked that.
Product images: the only image on the page is the older Cortech Endurance color chart. The Cortech product page has two Mini Can photos (Midnight Blue and Overcast). Would you like me to add them, and replace the chart with the new 18-color chart?
